source.check: deemed re-elected: 'No nomination was received for Somerset Division, the outgoing member for which was Mr. John Henry' (Irish News 18 May 1949 p3, block image read); under the 1949 regulations (S.R.&O. 1949 No. 18, reg. 15(1)) the eligible retiring member was declared deemed re-elected.

note: Triennial election of the 21 electoral divisions of Coleraine rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. The Irish News prints the full nomination list of 18 May. Twenty members were nominated unopposed and Aghadowey had two nominations, but Workman's was declared invalid, so there was no poll. Aghadowey was not polled after all: Matthew Workman's nomination was declared invalid, leaving W. J. Anderson returned unopposed (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6); Somerset, with no nomination, returned its retiring member John Henry as deemed re-elected (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). John Henry is again returned for Somerset in 1958 (Londonderry Standard, 21 May 1958, p. 3). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
